---
layout: page
permalink: /publications/
title: publications
#description: publications by categories in reversed chronological order. generated by jekyll-scholar.
nav: true
nav_order: 2
---
<style>
  /* =========================================================
     PUBLICATIONS PAGE — WHITE / BLACK ACADEMIC STYLE
     ========================================================= */

  .publications {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1000px;
    margin: 0 auto;

    color: #111111;

    font-family:
      "Source Serif 4",
      Georgia,
      "Times New Roman",
      serif;

    font-size: 17px;
    line-height: 1.8;
  }

  /* =========================================================
     PUBLICATION ENTRIES
     ========================================================= */

  .publications .bibliography {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;

    list-style: none;
  }

  .publications .bibliography li {
    position: relative;

    margin: 0 0 22px;
    padding: 22px 24px;

    background: #ffffff;

    border: 1px solid #d2d2d2;
    border-radius: 8px;

    color: #111111;

    box-shadow:
      0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07);

    transition:
      transform 0.25s ease,
      box-shadow 0.25s ease,
      border-color 0.25s ease;
  }

  .publications .bibliography li:hover {
    transform: translateY(-3px);

    border-color: #999999;

    box-shadow:
      0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
  }

  /* =========================================================
     PUBLICATION TEXT
     ========================================================= */

  .publications .bibliography li,
  .publications .bibliography li p {
    color: #222222;

    font-family:
      "Source Serif 4",
      Georgia,
      "Times New Roman",
      serif;

    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.8;

    text-align: justify;
    text-justify: inter-word;
  }

  /* Publication title */
  .publications .title {
    color: #000000 !important;

    font-family:
      Georgia,
      "Times New Roman",
      serif;

    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 700;

    line-height: 1.55;
  }

  /* Authors */
  .publications .author {
    color: #222222;

    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.7;
  }

  /* Venue / journal / conference */
  .publications .periodical,
  .publications .journal,
  .publications .booktitle {
    color: #444444;

    font-style: italic;
  }

  /* Year */
  .publications .year {
    color: #000000;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  /* =========================================================
     LINKS
     ========================================================= */

  .publications a {
    color: #000000 !important;

    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;

    transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
  }

  .publications a:hover {
    color: #000000 !important;
    opacity: 0.6;
  }

  /* =========================================================
     PUBLICATION BUTTONS
     ========================================================= */

  .publications .btn,
  .publications .btn-sm {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    margin-top: 8px;
    margin-right: 6px;

    padding: 5px 12px;

    background: #ffffff !important;
    color: #000000 !important;

    border: 1px solid #000000;
    border-radius: 4px;

    font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;

    text-decoration: none !important;

    transition:
      background-color 0.2s ease,
      color 0.2s ease,
      transform 0.2s ease;
  }

  .publications .btn:hover,
  .publications .btn-sm:hover {
    background: #000000 !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;

    border-color: #000000;

    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }

  /* =========================================================
     BADGES / TAGS
     ========================================================= */

  .publications .badge {
    display: inline-block;

    padding: 4px 9px;

    background: #f4f4f4 !important;
    color: #222222 !important;

    border: 1px solid #cccccc;
    border-radius: 4px;

    font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  /* =========================================================
     BIBSEARCH
     ========================================================= */

  .publications .bibsearch,
  .publications #bibsearch {
    margin-bottom: 25px;
  }

  .publications input[type="text"],
  .publications input[type="search"] {
    background: #ffffff !important;
    color: #111111 !important;

    border: 1px solid #bdbdbd;
    border-radius: 5px;

    font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;

    padding: 9px 12px;

    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
  }

  .publications input[type="text"]:focus,
  .publications input[type="search"]:focus {
    border-color: #000000;

    outline: none;

    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  }

  /* =========================================================
     DIVIDERS
     ========================================================= */

  .publications hr {
    border: none;
    border-top: 2px solid #000000;

    margin: 30px 0;
  }

  /* =========================================================
     FOOTER
     ========================================================= */

  .site-footer {
    background: #ffffff !important;
    color: #111111 !important;

    border-top: 2px solid #000000;

    margin-top: 0;
    padding: 25px 0;
  }

  .site-footer p {
    margin: 0;

    color: #111111 !important;

    text-align: center;

    font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  /* =========================================================
     TABLET
     ========================================================= */

  @media (max-width: 900px) {

    .publications {
      padding-left: 20px;
      padding-right: 20px;

      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .publications .bibliography li {
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .publications .bibliography li,
    .publications .bibliography li p {
      font-size: 15.5px;
    }
  }

  /* =========================================================
     MOBILE
     ========================================================= */

  @media (max-width: 768px) {

    .publications {
      padding-left: 15px;
      padding-right: 15px;

      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .publications .bibliography li {
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 7px;
    }

    .publications .bibliography li,
    .publications .bibliography li p {
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .publications .title {
      font-size: 17px;
    }

    .publications .author {
      font-size: 15px;
    }
  }

  /* =========================================================
     SMALL MOBILE
     ========================================================= */

  @media (max-width: 480px) {

    .publications {
      padding-left: 10px;
      padding-right: 10px;
    }

    .publications .bibliography li {
      padding: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .publications .bibliography li,
    .publications .bibliography li p {
      font-size: 14.5px;
    }

    .publications .title {
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .publications .btn,
    .publications .btn-sm {
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 5px 10px;
    }

    .site-footer {
      padding: 22px 0;
    }
  }
</style>

<!-- Bibsearch Feature -->

{% include bib_search.liquid %}

<div class="publications">

  {% bibliography %}

</div>
